name: @go-faster/fs-admin-frontend
description: go-faster/fs admin dashboard — Gravity UI console over an Orval-generated typed API client.
comment:overrides: GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (DoS via unbounded brace expansion) covers every brace-expansion <= 5.0.7, so there is no patched 1.x to float to. Both paths that reach it here are build-time only — orval's spectral ruleset and the codemods @gravity-ui/navigation ships as a dependency — and neither is in the browser bundle, but pinning the patched line keeps the tree clean rather than carrying a known-vulnerable transitive. Drop this once minimatch upstream stops resolving to 1.x.
